# pve_sdn_controller (Resource)

SDN controller configuration (bgp, evpn, faucet, isis).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_controller" "example" {
controller = "CHANGE_ME"
type = "bgp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `controller` (String) The SDN controller object identifier.
- `type` (String) Plugin type. One of: `bgp`, `evpn`, `faucet`, `isis`.

### Optional

- `asn` (Number) autonomous system number
- `bgp_mode` (String) Whether to use eBGP or iBGP. Auto mode chooses depending on BGP controller or falls back to iBGP. (default: auto) One of: `auto`, `external`, `internal`.
- `bgp_multipath_as_path_relax` (Boolean) Consider different AS paths of equal length for multipath computation.
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `ebgp` (Boolean) Enable eBGP (remote-as external).
- `ebgp_multihop` (Number) Set maximum amount of hops for eBGP peers.
- `fabric` (String) SDN fabric to use as underlay for this EVPN controller.
- `isis_domain` (String) Name of the IS-IS domain.
- `isis_ifaces` (String) Comma-separated list of interfaces where IS-IS should be active.
- `isis_net` (String) Network Entity title for this node in the IS-IS network.
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `loopback` (String) Name of the loopback/dummy interface that provides the Router-IP.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `nodes` (String) List of cluster node names.
- `peer_group_name` (String) Name of the peer group for this EVPN controller (default: VTEP)
- `peers` (String) peers address list.
- `route_map_in` (String) Route Map that should be applied for incoming routes
- `route_map_out` (String) Route Map that should be applied for outgoing routes

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: controller (also the `terraform import` format).
